quotes.text: if we've got the ability to do stuff at the edge, we kind of should, because it's quicker, faster, cheaper, and more resilient in terms of your closer to the person you're trying to help.
quotes.speaker: Fergus Kidd
quotes.why: States the core argument for running AI at the edge for frontline workers.

quotes.text: So the beautiful thing about small language models is that they don't always have this kind of inherent confidence that they know everything because their training sets are much smaller.
quotes.speaker: Fergus Kidd
quotes.why: Explains why a focused small model can be more trustworthy than a general one.

quotes.text: So for us, small language models are actually more powerful than large language models because they don't get distracted, they don't go off down on tangents
quotes.speaker: Fergus Kidd
quotes.why: A clear, contrarian position on choosing SLMs over LLMs for domain-specific work.

quotes.text: I was really against prompt engineering when that came out as a phrase by the way I hated the phrase prompt engineering, but now I think it's a core skill.
quotes.speaker: Fergus Kidd
quotes.why: An honest change of mind that frames prompting as an essential AI skill.

quotes.text: In AI, I would love to bust the myth that like AI is going to replace jobs. I just don't think that's where we are today.
quotes.speaker: Fergus Kidd
quotes.why: Pushes back on the job-replacement narrative with a practitioner's view.

takeaways: Frontline workers make up most of the workforce but are rarely the focus of AI, and they need voice-first, offline-capable tools that fit how they actually work.
Agentic AI on Azure AI Foundry lets one conversational interface orchestrate specialised agents for knowledge lookup, note taking and report filling, improving data quality at the point of entry.
Small language models grounded in curated data via Azure AI Search can be more reliable than large general models, provided the right information and good prompts go in.
hook: Most AI talk targets desk workers, yet the technicians, installers and inspectors in the field still drown in paperwork with little connectivity. Microsoft MVP Fergus Kidd, co-founder and CTO of FieldPal AI, shows builders and IT leaders how agentic AI on Azure AI Foundry, small language models and edge thinking can turn a short voice conversation into a complete, clean report.
